# omada_attack_defense (Resource)

Manages the gateway's attack-defense settings: flood defense, packet-anomaly filtering and IP-options filtering.

This is a singleton per site — import it with the site name rather than creating it. Attributes left unset are not written and keep whatever the controller already has.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Gateway attack defense.
#
# Only the attributes listed here are managed; anything left unset keeps
# whatever the controller already has, so this can be adopted incrementally.
resource "omada_attack_defense" "this" {
  # Don't answer pings from the internet.
  ping_wan_enable = false

  # Flood defense.
  tcp_conn_enable  = true
  udp_conn_enable  = true
  icmp_conn_enable = true

  # Packet anomaly.
  tcp_noflag_enable    = true
  tcp_winnuke_enable   = true
  tcp_fin_syn_enable   = true
  tcp_fin_noack_enable = true
  ping_death_enable    = true

  # Drop packets carrying IPv4 header options.
  ip_option_enable = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `icmp_conn_enable` (Boolean) Limit the rate of new ICMP connections (ICMP flood defense).
- `icmp_src_enable` (Boolean) Limit new ICMP connections per source address.
- `ip_option_enable` (Boolean) Filter packets carrying IPv4 header options. Master switch for the ipopt_* settings.
- `ipopt_loose_route_enable` (Boolean) Drop packets with the Loose Source Route IP option.
- `ipopt_noop_enable` (Boolean) Drop packets with the No-Operation IP option.
- `ipopt_record_route_enable` (Boolean) Drop packets with the Record Route IP option.
- `ipopt_secure_enable` (Boolean) Drop packets with the Security IP option.
- `ipopt_stream_enable` (Boolean) Drop packets with the Stream ID IP option.
- `ipopt_strict_route_enable` (Boolean) Drop packets with the Strict Source Route IP option.
- `ipopt_timestamp_enable` (Boolean) Drop packets with the Timestamp IP option.
- `ping_death_enable` (Boolean) Block ping-of-death (oversized/malformed ICMP echo).
- `ping_large_enable` (Boolean) Block oversized ping packets.
- `ping_wan_enable` (Boolean) Respond to ICMP echo requests arriving on the WAN. Disable to stop the gateway answering pings from the internet.
- `site` (String) Site name. Defaults to the primary site. Changing forces replacement.
- `tcp_conn_enable` (Boolean) Limit the rate of new TCP connections (TCP flood defense).
- `tcp_fin_noack_enable` (Boolean) Drop TCP FIN packets without ACK.
- `tcp_fin_syn_enable` (Boolean) Drop TCP packets with both FIN and SYN set.
- `tcp_noflag_enable` (Boolean) Drop TCP packets with no flags set.
- `tcp_scan_reject` (Boolean) Reject TCP scans. Only effective if the gateway reports support for it.
- `tcp_src_enable` (Boolean) Limit new TCP connections per source address.
- `tcp_winnuke_enable` (Boolean) Block WinNuke (out-of-band data) attacks.
- `udp_conn_enable` (Boolean) Limit the rate of new UDP connections (UDP flood defense).
- `udp_src_enable` (Boolean) Limit new UDP connections per source address.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The site ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Attack-defense settings are a singleton per site — import by site name.
terraform import omada_attack_defense.this Home
```
